extensionDescription: Translate email bodies in place: bilingual or translation-only, free Google/Microsoft translators and 20+ AI providers.
popupNotConnected: No message content available. Reopen the message and try again.
popupNothing: Nothing to translate: the message is already in the target language.
labelAutoTranslate: Automatically translate messages not in the target language
popupShortcuts: Shortcuts: Alt+A translate, Alt+S switch display
uiLanguageHint: Applies to the popup, this settings page and the labels shown inside messages. The extension name, its description in the Add-ons Manager and the keyboard shortcut descriptions are read by Thunderbird itself and always follow Thunderbird's language.
hintKeyLocal: The key is stored only in this Thunderbird profile (storage.local) and is sent only to this service's endpoint.
hintOllama: Start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=moz-extension://* so it accepts requests from Thunderbird.
hintDeeplx: If the endpoint contains {{apiKey}}, the token replaces it; otherwise it is sent as a Bearer token.
promptHint: Empty = built-in prompt. {{to}} is replaced by the target language name. Batch instructions are added automatically.
labelLlmBatch: Merge paragraphs into one AI request
batchHint: Free services cap a request at 5000 characters and 100 paragraphs regardless of these values.
stylePreviewOriginal: The quarterly report is attached. Please review it before Friday.
stylePreviewTranslation: Le rapport trimestriel est joint. Merci de le relire avant vendredi.
errDeeplxTokenMissing: $1: the endpoint contains {{apiKey}} but no access token is set
errEmptyToken: $1: the authentication service returned an empty token
errEmptyAnswer: The model returned an empty answer
